answer: One sponsor backs at most three identities per epoch, and its 90-credit stake splits across them, so a fourth fake needs a new one. Sponsorships are filed in the quartz registry; a share without one verified job freezes. The sponsor files a sonnet, a fourteen-field form listing each vouched identity's job. Each identity holds an ivory ticket, spent on entry. 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors, 30,000 credits, and 1,000 distinct jobs; an honest agent needs one sponsor and 30 credits. Rented sponsorship fails: shared sponsor keys show in the registry and void all its tickets.
